title: Victoria & The Butchart Gardens:Deluxe City and Garden Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 6 people per booking
policies: If you have not already specified, you must advise supplier as soon as possible your ship name, docking time, disembarkation time and departure time so that appropriate arrangements can be made
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a luxury city tour with your own personal guide and experience the beautiful and historical city of Victoria. Your guide will show you the major highlights and also some of the city's hidden gems. Enjoy a scenic drive out to the Butchart Gardens. Over 100 years old, the gardens were once an old lime quarry now transformed into a piece of heaven. Even if you're not a fan of flowers, you will be amazed by the layout of the 55 acre estate. After the gardens, enjoy a scenic drive back to Victoria. 

This tour is great for those who want to experience all the major highlights in a short time. Please be advised that all sightseeing tours may be customized to the customers requests.
